The deprecated strike tag renders as strikethrough

```csharp title="C#"
using System;
using HtmlToMarkdown;

var result = HtmlToMarkdownConverter.Convert("<p><strike>gone</strike></p>", new ConversionOptions());
Console.WriteLine(result.Content);
```
